gguf_q4_k_m.reason: lm_eval 0.4.13 gguf backend (models/gguf.py) posts to /v1/completions with echo=true and reads logprobs.text_offset/tokens/token_logprobs/top_logprobs dicts (OpenAI legacy format). The local llama-server (b12567) ignores echo (probe returned only the 1 generated token) and returns logprobs.content[] in the new format, so prompt-token log-likelihoods are unavailable and the backend cannot score choices. No llama-cpp-python is installed. Probe: eval_cache/lm040/probe.py
